title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Advisor tool result content could not be processed
body:
**Bug Description**
it's completely broken. I randomly get these "Advisor tool result content could not be processed." - and I just can't send anymore messages. I'm stuck with these 400 errors. If I ctrl+c and come back in, it's still stuck with these same errors.

I'm able to work around it by having another claude clean up the broken transcript:

```
⏺ Done. Removed the broken advisor pair (uuids 8379bfb2… and 65edf1fa…) and re-pointed the next thinking block's parentUuid to bridge the gap. Chain integrity verified — 0 orphans, 0 remaining advisor
  references. Backup saved alongside as .bak.1776469470.

  Root cause: Claude Code persisted the advisor_tool_result.content as a Python repr() of a dict (single-quoted {'type': 'advisor_redacted_result', ...}) instead of valid JSON, so the API rejected every replay.

  To pick up the fix: exit this session (Claude Code holds the conversation in memory), then claude -r 4d73bbb0-c2f1-48dd-8acc-b96c3d3bf727 — the next reload will read the cleaned file. If anything looks wrong,
   restore with mv …jsonl.bak.1776469470 …jsonl.

  Worth filing as a Claude Code bug (advisor result serialization). Reproducer: any /advisor call in a transcript you later resume.
```

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Superset
- Version: 2.1.113
- Feedback ID: f69963c8-436a-4d4a-a5e3-b2f689cadbf5
